info.title: World Open API
info.description:
Public 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) **world** APIs: create reconstruction/generation jobs, poll details, and paginate lists.

**Path prefix** (relative to gateway): `/global/world/v1` (e.g. `POST /global/world/v1/reconstructions` on the international gateway).

**Async jobs**: create APIs return `WorldAsyncOperation` with `worldId` only; poll **Get world details** until a terminal state.

**Resources**: for reconstruction with images (`type=image` or omit `type`), need **≥20** images; for video-only set `type` to `video`.

**Time & paging**: `createTime` / `updateTime` are Unix **milliseconds**; lists use `pageNum` / `pageSize`.

**Auth**: header `Authorization` with API key (no `Bearer` prefix).

**Responses**: HTTP 200 returns business objects; failures return unified error body with biz codes.

post.description:
Creates an async 3DGS world reconstruction job. On acceptance, returns `WorldAsyncOperation` with `worldId` only (same as **Get world details** `{worldId}`).
**Resource formats**: image: .jpg / .jpeg / .png / .webp; video: .mp4 / .mov; insv: .insv.
**Rules**: if `resources` include images (`type=image` or omit `type`), need **≥20** image entries; for video set `type=video`; for Insta360 panoramic video set `type=insv` (neither triggers the 20-image rule).

requestBody.description: Create-job body; when using images, meet the count rules in `CreateWorldRequest`.

createWorldWithVideo.description: Single video + indoor scene; `type: video`, supports .mp4 / .mov

createWorldWithImages.description: Multi-image: need ≥20 `image` entries (or omit `type` to count as image), supports .jpg / .jpeg / .png / .webp; example is truncated—real calls need 20+ items.

400.description: Invalid body/parameters, insufficient credits, etc. (`ApiError`; legacy biz code in `details.metaData.bizCode`)

insufficientCredits.description: Legacy biz code 11003; may not apply if create does not charge credits.

taskMattingError.description: Legacy biz code 11004; may not occur on this path.

notLoggedIn.summary: Not logged in or authentication failed

429.description: Global task concurrency or rate limit (`ApiError`)

x-codeSamples.label: Aholo SDK (TypeScript)
Aholo SDK (Java)
Aholo SDK (Python)
x-codeSamples.source:
from manycore.aholo_sdk_world import create_world_client

world = create_world_client(region='com')
op = world.reconstructions.create(
    name='Living room',
    resources=[{'url': 'https://cdn.example.com/room.mp4', 'type': 'video'}],
    task_quality='normal',
    scene='model',
)
detail = world.wait_for(op['worldId'])
print(detail.get('assets', {}).get('splats', {}).get('urls', {}).get('plyPath'))

post.description: Creates an async 3DGS world generation job (Spatial Gen). **Indoor** scenes are more mature and stable today; non-indoor input is allowed but still **Beta** and may be materially weaker than indoor—assess risk accordingly. On acceptance returns `WorldAsyncOperation` (`worldId` only). Supports text-only, a single image, or text + image. If `resources` includes an image, at most one (image: .jpg / .jpeg / .png / .webp).

requestBody.description: Generation request body. Supports text-only, a single image, or text + image. At most one image (image: .jpg / .jpeg / .png / .webp).

400.description: Invalid body/parameters or other business errors (`ApiError`)

notLoggedIn.summary: Not logged in or authentication failed

get.description: Get details by world id. When reconstruction succeeds, splat (ply/spz) URLs may be present; after LOD post-processing, `assets.splats.urls.lodMetaPath` has LOD chunk metadata. For AI-generated (Spatial Gen) worlds, `assets.imagery.panoUrl` returns the panorama download URL once available.

200.description: On success, the body is a world detail object.

reconstructionWorldDetail.description: Reconstruction succeeded with splats and coordinate metadata; no imagery.

generateWorldDetail.description: Generation succeeded with panorama `imagery.panoUrl` and splats.

400.description: Path parameter validation or other business errors (`ApiError`)

resources.description: Input resources (≥1). Formats see CreateWorldRequest description (image: .jpg / .jpeg / .png / .webp; video: .mp4 / .mov; insv: .insv). With images, need ≥20 image entries (`type=image` or omit); for video set `type=video`; for Insta360 panoramic video set `type=insv`.

useMask.description: Whether to segment uploaded resources. `true` enables matting; omit or `false` to skip.

CreateWorldRequest.description:
Body for **Create 3DGS world reconstruction**. `scene` is `model` or `space`; see `WorldOpenApiTaskQuality` for `taskQuality` (`low` fast preview / `normal` standard / `high` professional).
**Resource formats**: image: .jpg / .jpeg / .png / .webp; video: .mp4 / .mov; insv: .insv.
**Counts**: if any image-type resource (`type=image` or omit `type`), need **≥20** image entries; for video or Insta360 panoramic video, set `type=video` or `type=insv` on each (no 20-image rule).

WorldOpenApiResourceType.description: Input resource type. `image`: images, supports .jpg / .jpeg / .png / .webp; `video`: standard video, supports .mp4 / .mov; `insv`: Insta360 panoramic video, supports .insv.

WorldOpenApiTaskQuality.description: Reconstruction quality tier: `low` fast preview; `normal` standard; `high` professional.

url.description: Resource URL; file extension must match `type` (image: .jpg / .jpeg / .png / .webp; video: .mp4 / .mov; insv: .insv).

WorldResourceItem.description: One reconstruction input resource. Omit `type` → image; standard video → `video`; Insta360 panoramic video → `insv`. image: .jpg / .jpeg / .png / .webp; video: .mp4 / .mov; insv: .insv.

worldId.description: World id; use as `{worldId}` in `GET /global/world/v1/{worldId}` to poll status and outputs.

WorldAsyncOperation.description: Async create acceptance: returns `worldId` for polling details until a terminal state.

message.description: Developer-facing error message (English); use `localizedMessage` for user-visible localized text.
message.example: Permission denied to access this resource

ApiError.description: API error response with status, details, and optional help.

Code.description: REST API status code per Google API design guidelines.

reason.description: Error reason identifier in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (max 63 characters).

message.example: The requested design with ID 12345 does not exist

domain.description: Error domain, usually the service that produced the error.

additionalProperties.description: Additional metadata as key/value pairs (keys up to 64 chars, pattern /[a-zA-Z0-9-_]/).

metaData.description: Additional metadata as key/value pairs (keys up to 64 chars, pattern /[a-zA-Z0-9-_]/).

ErrorDetails.description: Error details: reason, domain, and metadata.

desc.description: Description of the linked help document.
desc.example: How to resolve permission denied errors

Help.description: Help link and description for resolving the error.

message.description: Localized error text for end users
message.example: You do not have permission to access this resource

LocalizedMessage.description: Localized message for a specific locale.

pageSize.description: Page size (max 100); defaults to 20 when 0 or omitted.

statusList.description: Filter by reconstruction status; empty means no status filter.

WorldListQueryRequest.description: List body: `pageNum` from 0, `pageSize` 1–100 (default 20 when 0 or omitted). Returns 3DGS worlds for the current account only.

WorldOpenApiTaskStatus.description: Task status. **In progress**: `PENDING` queued; `PREPROCESSING` preprocessing; `RUNNING` running. **Terminal**: `SUCCEEDED` succeeded; `FAILED` failed; `CANCELED` canceled; `TIMEOUT` timeout; `REJECTED` rejected.

lodMetaPath.description: LOD chunk metadata download URL (`output.lodMetaPath`); present after successful LOD post-processing, else null.

SplatFileUrls.description: 3DGS splat download URLs: PLY / SPZ and optional LOD metadata (same fields as task output).

WorldAssetBundle.description: World output bundle. On 3D reconstruction success, `splats` is filled (ply/spz/lodMetaPath under `splats.urls`); AI generation additionally returns the panorama URL at `imagery.panoUrl`.

worldId.description: World id; create APIs return the same value in `WorldAsyncOperation.worldId`.

WorldDetail.description: World record: `worldId` is the business world id; `scene`/`status` are convention strings; `createTime` / `updateTime` are Unix milliseconds. When outputs are ready, details may include splat URLs; AI-generated worlds also return the panorama at `assets.imagery.panoUrl`.

panoUrl.description: AI-generated panorama download URL. Present only when the pano subtask succeeds for AI-generated (Spatial Gen) worlds.

WorldImagery.description: Image outputs for AI-generated worlds; currently only the panorama download URL.

WorldOpenApiUpAxis.description: World coordinate up axis. `Y`: +Y up (glTF/USD default); `Z`: +Z up (3DGS output convention for this service).

pageNum.description: Page index used for this request (0-based).

pageSize.description: Page size used for this request.

result.description: Rows for this page (WorldOpen mapping; list uses withResult=false by default).

WorldPagedList.description: Paged list with `pageNum` / `pageSize`, current page rows, and totals.

WorldSemanticsMetadata.description: Semantics metadata (camera pose, scale, offset, coordinate conventions, etc.). When splat outputs are returned, includes `upAxis` to indicate the coordinate system.

resources.description: Input resources; provide `prompt` and/or resources. Images only, at most one; omit `type` → image. image: .jpg / .jpeg / .png / .webp.

GenerateWorldRequest.description: Body for world generation: text-only, one image, or both. Indoor scenes are more mature; non-indoor is Beta (see POST operation). Require non-empty `prompt` or at least one image resource (at most one); image: .jpg / .jpeg / .png / .webp.

url.description: Image resource URL; extension must be image: .jpg / .jpeg / .png / .webp.

GenerateWorldResourceItem.description: One generation input resource (image). Omit `type` → image. image: .jpg / .jpeg / .png / .webp.

WorldOpenApiGenResourceType.description: Generation input resource type; image only, supports .jpg / .jpeg / .png / .webp.

AuthorizationHeader.description: Open platform credential. API key auth: set header `Authorization` to your platform **API key** (no `Bearer` prefix).
AuthorizationHeader.name: Authorization
